sections.voiceover: NASA officially ended the Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory mission. Operating for 22 years, the spacecraft recorded its final observation on October 20. When will the decaying observatory re-enter Earth's atmosphere?
sections.visual_cue: Telescope instruments capturing final light data
b_roll: NASA Science mission control archival footage

sections.voiceover: Arizona company Katalyst Space Technologies tried a private rescue mission that failed.
Arizona company Katalyst Space Technologies tried boosting the decaying orbit using their LINK spacecraft. Re-entering Earth's atmosphere in November, the observatory's 22-year mission ends.
sections.visual_cue: Spacecraft approaching a decaying satellite orbit

sections.voiceover: Twenty-two years of cosmic history ends in fire.
